summary: Corebridge Financial filed an 8-K solely to announce the proposed leadership team of the combined company following a previously announced all-stock merger with Equitable Holdings. The filing does not disclose new deal terms, price, premium, or board recommendation; it merely updates post-merger management appointments. This is a routine update to a prior transaction, not a new special-situation event. The merger was announced on March 26, 2026, and the combined company's CEO will be Corebridge's current CEO. No new financial details, regulatory triggers, or risk-arb angles are provided. The 8-K is informational only, with no actionable deal mechanics.
